codon.summary: Rare-codon clusters and low Relative Codon Adaptation (affects elongation AND mRNA stability)

composition.summary: Local GC troughs (silencing risk; LOW GC is the hazard) and homopolymer runs

cloning.summary: Internal Type IIS sites (BsaI/BsmBI/BbsI/SapI) that break MoClo assembly

structure.summary: Start codon presence, 5'UTR length, and start-region secondary structure

uorf.summary: Upstream AUGs / uORFs in the 5'UTR that compete with the main start

instability.summary: Clustered AU-rich elements (AREs) that destabilise the transcript

polya.summary: Premature Cr poly(A) signals (TGTAA in a G/C-rich context) that truncate the transcript

splice.summary: Cr-type splice sites: intended-intron sanity check and accidental splice pairs

silencing.summary: HEURISTIC: sequence-visible silencing risk (GC troughs) + strain/intron guidance

flags.message: BsaI site (GGTCTC, + strand) in cds. Domesticate before MoClo assembly.
flags.evidence: Crozet 2018 (algal MoClo); Schroda 2019 — Type IIS domestication is standard for Cr

flags.message: Premature poly(A) signal TGTAA inside the CDS in a G/C-rich context (GC 90%). Risks 3' cleavage and a truncated transcript.
flags.evidence: Shen 2008 (PMID 18493049); Zhao 2014 (PMC4025486): Cr NUE is UGUAA in G/C-rich context
flags.suggested_edit: no clean synonymous fix — constraint conflict (no synonymous change removes the motif)

flags.message: Upstream AUG at 5'UTR position 5: uAUG out of frame, overlapping the main start. Strong initiation context.
flags.evidence: ribosome scanning: 5'UTR AUGs divert initiation from the main ORF
flags.suggested_edit: mutate the uAUG (e.g. ATG->ACG) in the 5'UTR if it is not functional

flags.message: HEURISTIC guidance: Silencing in Cr is driven mainly by chromatin/strain, not CDS sequence. Use a silencing-deficient strain (e.g. UVM4/UVM11) and an intron-containing promoter, and include an intron (e.g. rbcS2 intron 1). This module reports only sequence-visible risk (GC troughs), never a sequence verdict.
flags.evidence: Schroda 2019; Neupert/Bock UVM strains — silencing is chromatin/strain-driven

flags.message: Poly(A) signal TGTAA with G/C-rich context in 3'UTR (context GC 88%) — expected here, not a hazard.
flags.evidence: Shen 2008 (PMID 18493049); Zhao 2014 (PMC4025486): Cr NUE is UGUAA in G/C-rich context

limitations: Transcript-level only: splicing/processing, mRNA stability, translation initiation, silencing-risk features.
SILENT on proteolysis and protein stability — a real cause of low yield it cannot see. A clean report is NOT a promise of expression.
Diagnostic, not predictive: NO composite expression score is emitted.
This nuclear report says nothing about a chloroplast construct.
poly(A) is the noisiest module; its operating point comes from Leg-1, not assumption. The shipped codon table is a starting point (see provenance).
